RADIJATOR INŽENJERING developed the TKAN boiler to offer the market a boiler with mechanical and thermal properties specifically suited to biomass fuel. At the same time, the market consistently demands greater fuel flexibility, so the TKAN can also burn wood, which requires manual loading.
Po spoljašnjem dizajnu, dimenzijama loži: In its external design, combustion chamber dimensions, and fuel-loading and cleaning openings, the TKAN retains all the strengths of earlier models for which RADIJATOR INŽENJERING is known in the market. The boiler's water section and the transfer of heat from flue gases to water through a tubular heat exchanger are adapted to biomass. The use of a fan, providing forced draught, creates a longer flue gas path than in standard boilers. This also allows the use of flue gas flow devices known as turbulators, which further increase boiler efficiency. The turbulators are spirals made from a special material.
Efficiency exceeds 90% when burning pellets. Under normal operating conditions, the flue gas temperature at the outlet is approximately 160 °C, and at maximum output it remains below 180 °C. These values can be read on the display at any time.
Svi delovi vodenog dela kotla izrađeni s: All components of the boiler's water section use seamless ST 35.4 tubes and boiler steel plates at least 5 mm thick, depending on boiler output. The plates are grade 1.0425 under the EU standard, or P265GH under the EUII standard. The combustion chamber operates on an underfeed principle: fuel moves vertically upwards from the conveying zone into the combustion zone. It uses substantial insulating materials and grey cast iron. Screw conveyors transport the fuel.

TKAN INTEGRA predstavlja novu generaciju: TKAN INTEGRA is a new generation of industrial biomass boilers, developed as an improvement on the standard TKAN model. It responds to market demand for greater automation, higher energy efficiency and more reliable operation, while retaining all the proven design solutions for which RADIJATOR INŽENJERING is known.
Zahvaljujući zidanom ložištu, unapređeno: With its refractory-lined combustion chamber, improved combustion system, modern controls and more extensive standard equipment, TKAN INTEGRA provides stable operation, maximum energy utilisation and a long service life for all key components. The boiler structure uses high-quality boiler steel plates at least 6 mm thick, and the tubular heat exchanger uses seamless boiler tubes, ensuring high mechanical strength, reliability and a long system service life.
Zidano ložište predstavlja jednu od klju: The refractory-lined combustion chamber is one of the key advantages of the TKAN INTEGRA model. This design enables complete and stable fuel combustion, minimal emissions of harmful gases and dust particles, and maximum utilisation of the energy in pellets. At the same time, the boiler's steel components have no direct exposure to the flame, significantly extending boiler service life.
Za smanjenje količine čestica koje odlaz: A cyclone reduces the quantity of particles entering the chimney. Larger configurations use a multicyclone with a centrifugal fan. The manufacturer particularly recommends a cyclone when using pneumatic heat exchanger cleaning, as this expels additional ash and soot from the boiler. Larger TKAN Integra models use a multicyclone with a centrifugal fan. Specifically, the TKAN 80 Integra and TKAN 100 Integra have a fan on the flue outlet, while the TKAN 150 Integra, TKAN 200 Integra, TKAN 250 Integra and TKAN 300 Integra have a multicyclone with a centrifugal fan.
Kod pojedinih TKAN konfiguracija koristi: Some TKAN configurations use a fan on the flue gas side, while larger systems may have a multicyclone equipped with a centrifugal fan. This matters when designing the complete chimney system, particularly where there are several boilers, a longer flue duct, a cyclone or multicyclone, multiple bends or a shared chimney.
Kotlovi serije TKAN INTEGRA standardno s: TKAN INTEGRA boilers include an automatic cleaning system for the area around the combustion chamber as standard. Compressed air automatically cleans the tubular heat exchanger. Periodic air pulses remove soot deposits from the flue tubes, maintain high boiler efficiency and significantly reduce the need for manual maintenance.
